title: General Self-Efficacy Scale
description: 10 statements rated 1–4 (not at all true to exactly true).

holder.name: Ralf Schwarzer and Matthias Jerusalem (Freie Universität Berlin)

citation.text: Schwarzer R, Jerusalem M (1995). Generalized Self-Efficacy scale. In: Weinman J, Wright S, Johnston M (eds). Measures in health psychology: a user's portfolio. Causal and control beliefs. Windsor: NFER-Nelson, pp. 35–37.

scoring.text: Sum of the 10 items (10–40). Scoring here follows the published literature; check it against the manual or form your lab holds before publishing.
